Definition: Cheptsi-bah, a fanciful name for Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Chephzibah is the name of Hezekiah's wife, the mother of Manasseh, and it is also the new name God gives His land. In Kings she appears only as a name in the royal line, but in Isaiah the Lord says the land shall no more be called desolate, it shall be called Hephzibah, for the Lord delights in it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God renames what was desolate with delight, and that is the hope I hold for every life He has claimed.
